documents.text: Welcome to our frequently asked questions regarding your upcoming stay. Regarding cancellations, please note that neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented in our current records. For your convenience, arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request; simply proceed to the front desk. Please be aware that while your holiday price covers the room, the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool. Furthermore, regarding activities, the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. We hope this clarifies the scope of your booking and any additional costs you may encounter during your visit.

Booking Confirmation: Your reservation for the Alder offer is now active. Please note that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Regarding arrival, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. While a swimming area is mentioned, its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated in this document. The quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.

*Footnotes:
1. For the unselected Birch offer only, the accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee.
2. Selected offer Alder. Distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer.

Agent: Hello, how can I help you today?
Guest: I have questions about my booking terms.
Agent: Certainly. Regarding refunds, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. For arrival, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. You mentioned the pool; a swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. The void old policy stated that the booked accommodation had an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee.
Guest: And the hike?
Agent: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Current selected terms completely replace the old policy.

Package Comparison Extract: Selected Option A vs. Option B. Refund Policy: Neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented for either package. Arrival: Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. Activity: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay.

Facility Conflict: Two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. Neither overrides the other. Applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states the booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. The conflicting policy states the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price.

Travel Agent Notes: Client selected stay for 8–15 May. Refund terms are favorable; before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. Arrival is seamless as arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. Regarding activities, the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Note: A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated in the distractor material, which applies exclusively to December stays and is therefore irrelevant to this booking.

Travel Agent Notes: Client inquiry regarding cancellation and arrival. Refund: Cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Arrival: A guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Facility: A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. Activity: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay.
